verdict.rationale: Luma's own Ray page says its Reframe feature "handles every aspect ratio" and that Modify Video V2 outputs "all at 1080p", so the product itself covers both reformatting and 1080p output. However, no evidence names 16:9, 9:16 or 1:1 for native text- or image-to-video generation, and 1080p is only stated for Modify Video V2 (Draft mode is 360p). missing for 10: explicit documentation of 16:9/9:16/1:1 output for generation, 1080p-or-above for standard generation, confirmation that exports are channel-ready without re-encoding, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding
